svg.title: Garance — Rubia tinctorum
svg.desc: Madder lifted with its dye-bearing roots: angular, lightly hooked stems carry conspicuous whorls of four to six narrow, pointed sage-green leaves. Loose forked stalks hold a few tiny yellow-green five-lobed flowers. Below the crown, a tangled bundle of slender crimson and rusty red roots divides into fine rootlets.
